summary: Turn a working meeting draft into a durable dated note while preserving the repository's established conventions.

scenarios.title: Archive the current meeting draft
scenarios.prompt: Use $promote-meeting-notes to finalize .docs/meetings/_draft.md using this repository's existing note format.
scenarios.outcome: One dated durable note with decisions and follow-ups preserved, followed by a safely reset working draft.

scenarios.title: Resolve an ambiguous meeting date
scenarios.prompt: Use $promote-meeting-notes on this draft, but ask before writing if the date or destination cannot be derived safely.
scenarios.outcome: A focused clarification instead of a misfiled or overwritten note, with prior meeting records left unchanged.
